test_remove_points_in_boxes: test ObjectSample.remove_points_in_boxes to filter LiDAR points inside 3D bounding boxes
test_object_sample: test ObjectSample augmentation to sample objects from a database into point clouds
test_object_noise: test ObjectNoise augmentation to apply random translation and rotation noise to 3D boxes
test_random_flip_3d: test RandomFlip3D augmentation to horizontally and vertically flip LiDAR points and 3D boxes
test_background_points_filter: test BackgroundPointsFilter to remove background points outside enlarged 3D bounding boxes
